messages:
Faye: quick ping 1: docs lint flagged handbook/recipes/token-optimization.md for an anchor mismatch that only appears on Linux builds (case-sensitivity). page has no owner. anyone can grab?
Hector: I ran into this locally. looks like the anchor is `#KV-cache` in the doc but other pages link to `#kv-cache` (lowercase). linux FS is picky.
Marta: oof. small fix but we should add owner frontmatter too. docs-bot usually wants an explicit owner.
docs-bot: automated-scan: anchor-case-mismatch detected in handbook/recipes/token-optimization.md (rule=docs.anchor-case). recommended action: canonicalize anchors to lowercase `#kv-cache` and add `owner: @Marta` frontmatter.
Faye: @Marta can you take ownership? if you prefer I can open the tiny PR.
Marta: I can do it. plan: 1) add `owner: @Marta` to top of file, 2) change the anchor to `#kv-cache` in doc and update two referring pages (runtime/faq and onboarding/quick-start), 3) open single PR.
Hector: small note: if you change the anchor, add an HTML redirect comment `<!-- anchor: KV-cache -->` so older links don't immediately 404 in some crawlers.
Marta: good call. will add that. also adding `<!-- eval-anchor: kv-cache -->` so our eval harness references are explicit.
Faye: sed snippet for frontmatter if helpful: `sed -i "1s/^/owner: @Marta\n/" handbook/recipes/token-optimization.md`
ci-bot: presubmit-check: please run `make docs-lint` locally; case-anchor lint runs in CI.
Marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/18080 title: "canonicalize kv-cache anchor + add owner" 1 requesting @Hector for a quick link sanity CR.
Hector: reviewing now. left 1 nit: runtime/faq had an extra space in the fragment; pushed a tiny fix.
Marta: pushed fix. CI green and link-check passed. merging on green.
ci-bot: merge: PR #18080 merged by @Marta. presubmit checks passed.
docs-bot: changelog: handbook/recipes/token-optimization.md owner=@Marta 1 anchor-case-mismatch resolved (added redirect comment).
Faye: great job, thanks! reminder for folks: filesystem case-sensitivity can bite. prefer lowercase anchors to avoid cross-platform flaps. :memo:
Marta: noted. I'll add a short note to the docs-contrib checklist about anchor casing rules.
